note: Page image 0004, the first line of the page: "Zu Urkund dessen habe ich ... Obligation". The word before "Obligation". The bond stands above this sentence, so "vorstehende" (the foregoing) is what one expects; compare the first letters with "vorstehende" in "die vorstehende Schuldverschreibung", ten lines further down the same page.
Page image 0007, the small fee note at the left edge, under the seal mark L. S.: "T. u. S. 2 rt. _ gg." The second figure. It looks to me like the first one, a 2.
Page image 0006, the first word of the third line: "vor unterschriebenen Com- / missari..". Only the ending is in doubt. One commissary, Stosch, signs below, with v. Zelislawski.
Page image 0009, the last word of the second line: "als eine Competenz zur Kalischsche..". Only the last letter is in doubt.

Page image 0003, the third line from the foot: "das ih. an dieser Cession zustehende Eigenthums Recht". The word after "das". The fund is "ihr" three lines above ("daß ich ihr in Ansehung dieser Summe").
